spec.description: Memory.stats.cpu.<system> — last tick's CPU used, per kernel system (kernel/tick.ts's SYSTEMS).
spec.title: CPU per system

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.energyAvailable — energy in the spawn/extension network right now, per colony.
spec.title: Energy available by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.energyCapacity — the "can I afford a body" ceiling, per colony.
spec.title: Energy capacity by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.storageEnergy — 0 before storage is built, per colony.
spec.title: Storage energy by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.controllerProgress — upgrade progress toward the next RCL, per colony.
spec.title: Controller progress by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.spawnLoad — required parts / spawn capacity. >=1 means spawns can't keep up.
spec.title: Spawn load by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.census.<role>.{current,desired}, summed across roles per colony — staffed fraction of desired census (A/B via a Grafana math expression query, since this graphite-api build lacks a multi-series asPercent/applyByNode).
spec.title: Census staffed % by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.buildings.<type>.{built,targeted}, summed across structure types per colony — built fraction of the current plan (A/B via a Grafana math expression query, since this graphite-api build lacks a multi-series asPercent/applyByNode).
spec.title: Buildings built % by colony

spec.description: Memory.stats.empire.resources.<resource> — empire-total stock (storage+terminal summed across every owned colony), per boost-line resource. Filter with the $resource variable — 41 boost-line resources share one flat 3,000 target by default (boostTargets.ts), too dense to read unfiltered.
spec.title: Empire resource stock

spec.description: Memory.stats.empire.deficits.<resource> — empire-total (effectiveTarget minus stock) summed across colonies; positive = empire-wide short, negative = empire-wide surplus. A snapshot written alongside empire/logistics.ts's own match pass for this export only — the matcher itself never persists this (decision 11, docs/empire-logistics-plan.md). Filter with $resource.
spec.title: Empire resource deficit (+short / -surplus)

spec.description: Memory.stats.rooms.<room>.numRemotes — distinct rooms among currently-selected remote sources.
spec.title: Remotes — $room
